title: Great Picture - Poor Ornament
text: Great Picture - Poor Ornament. The bell sent to me had been returned previously as the batteries that were included were cut off a strip of replacements.  The ornament was wadded into a few pieces of tissue paper and the bell itself, which is painted plastic was scratched a bit.  I should have read the previous reviews and the negative ones are the same as mine.  Not a quality ornament in this case.  And I am a big Hallmark ornament fan, so this one was a disappointment to say the least. I recommend this to no one.
